Q8245.reason: The absolute threshold is defined as the lowest intensity detected by 50% of observers; at 70%, only 15/30 (50%) responded while at 60% it was 10/30 (~33%), so no single level perfectly matches the standard definition without interpolation or more data.

Q8128.reason: Exercise-induced cough and congestion with normal spirometry in a patient with an asthmatic family history is classic for exercise-induced bronchoconstriction.

Q5479.reason: Conspiracy can be established if the defendant solicited and there was an apparent agreement to commit a crime, even if one party secretly lacked intent.
